hypotheses.A0_internal_disagreement_detects_bad_fou: At least 90% of sites with four-node endpoint cosine below 0.90 are prospectively flagged by 4-versus-8 disagreement.
hypotheses.A1_eight_nodes_are_typically_accurate: Eight-node prediction has median endpoint cosine at least 0.995 and norm-ratio error at most 0.02 in each layer.
hypotheses.A2_sixteen_nodes_resolve_flagged_paths: On flagged paths, sixteen-node median endpoint cosine is at least 0.95 and median norm-ratio error at most 0.10 in each layer.
hypotheses.A3_adaptive_continuous_compiler_preserve: Adaptive prediction recovers at least 0.80 effect-weighted KL and 0.90 median per-example KL in each layer.
hypotheses.A4_adaptive_support_is_compact_and_behav: Adaptive suffix-selected rank-256 support populated with endpoint values recovers at least 0.80 effect-weighted KL in each layer.
hypotheses.A5_internal_confidence_separates_errors: Unflagged paths have at least 0.20 greater median continuous recovery than flagged paths in each layer.
hypotheses.A6_adaptation_is_prospective: The 4-versus-8 convergence decision is frozen before sixteen-node and endpoint outcomes are inspected.
